# OkArthur

Chartered civil engineer. Digital, data and AI for owners delivering more than
one development at once.

OkArthur is the practice of Steven Yule, a chartered civil engineer (CEng FICE
FCIHT MIAM) based in Dubai. He is a Fellow of the Institution of Civil Engineers,
an ICE Policy Fellow and the ICE UAE Country Representative.

## Standard biography

Use verbatim. If space is short, cut from the end.

Steven Yule is a chartered civil engineer who leads digital, data and AI work
for infrastructure. Based in Dubai, he has spent 17 years across the Gulf and the
UK making technology useful once it meets a live capital programme, including as
project director of the first integrated infrastructure plan for the Riyadh
region. Through OkArthur he reviews decisions for owners delivering more than
one development at once, and advises boards. He is a Fellow of the Institution of Civil Engineers,
an ICE Policy Fellow, the ICE UAE Country Representative and a non-executive
director of Thomas Telford Ltd.

## What can be commissioned

An owner with several developments is measured on where the portfolio lands,
usually a range such as a return or a number of homes. When one development
slips, the question is what can move elsewhere to keep the portfolio in range.
The work below is built around that question.

Independent review. A written second opinion on one decision before an owner
commits. The decision might be a supplier's proposal or a business case. It
might also be a change of plan at group level that affects several
developments. Scope and end date are agreed before work starts. A fixed fee is
proposed after a first call.

Continuing advisory. Independent advice over several months, bought as a
retainer or a block of days agreed in advance. It typically covers client-side
support while a supplier delivers, or setting the scope and scoring of a
procurement before it goes to market. It can also cover testing a digital or
data strategy before it is funded.

Board and non-executive. Non-executive and advisory board appointments with
private companies in the UK and the UAE. They suit boards asked to approve
digital and AI investment they cannot test, or to hold a portfolio of
developments to its plan using reports written one development at a time.

Speaking and writing. Keynotes, panels, press comment and bylines on digital,
data and AI in infrastructure.

## Independence

Independence is written into each engagement. No delivery work and no
supplier-side work is taken on anything under review. Any interest is declared
before an engagement starts. Where a conflict cannot be cleanly separated, the
engagement is declined.

## Who it is for

Infrastructure owners, developers, government agencies and capital programme
clients in the GCC and the UK.
